prompt:
Below is a policy summary from a UK general election manifesto. Identify the party that produced it. You must choose one.

<text>
UKIP Manifesto 2017 – Summary (under 500 words)

Brexit and sovereignty
- Six Brexit tests: restore UK law supremacy (free of ECJ/ECHR jurisdiction if desired); full migration control; regain 200‑mile maritime zone and fisheries; independent trade policy outside Single Market and Customs Union; no “divorce bill” and return of UK assets; complete by end‑2019. Repeal 1964 London Fisheries Convention; revive fishing industry; bring back blue passports.

Economy, tax and cost of living
- Fund priorities via £35bn savings: reduce foreign aid to 0.2% GNI, scrap HS2, reform Barnett formula, end EU payments; no tax rises.
- Cut living costs: remove VAT from domestic energy and hot takeaways; scrap BBC licence fee; remove green levies; abolish VAT on sanitary products.
- Raise personal allowance to £13,500 and 40% threshold to £55,000; lift IHT threshold to £500k each; flexible state pension window, early option for women at 60; crack down on multinational tax avoidance.

Business and jobs
- 20% business rates cut for premises <£50k RV; penalise persistent late payers; open procurement to SMEs; no quarterly tax returns; freeze Insurance Premium Tax.
- “British jobs first”: require domestic advertising; allow preference for under‑25 UK applicants; tighten zero‑hours; enforce minimum/living wage.

Coastal, housing and local
- Coastal enterprise zones: 50% rates cut, housing standards enforcement, regeneration fund.
- Housing: 100,000 factory‑built modular homes/year via new HDC on brownfield; under‑40 first‑time buyers with 10% deposit; owner‑occupied only; sell‑back to HDC; review housing associations.

NHS and social care
- Extra £11bn/year by 2021/22 (NHS + social care); integrate health and care in a new department.
- Lift caps on medical/nurse training; restore nursing bursaries; fund med tuition for NHS service; 10,000 more GPs; scrap hospital parking; end PFI; toughen NHS eligibility for non‑contributors; guarantee EU health workers’ rights.

Mental health
- +£500m/year; 28‑day max waits; universal school counselling; improved liaison psychiatry and perinatal access; stronger support for serving personnel and veterans.

Education and families
- Grammar school in every town; expand technical/vocational tracks; abolish Key Stage 1 SATs.
- Scrap tuition fees for STEM and medicine with UK/NHS service; restore maintenance grants; stronger careers and employability teaching.
- Wrap‑around school childcare; £80m fund to include SEND children; 50/50 shared parenting presumption; more transparent Family Courts.

Elderly and disabled
- Maintain triple lock and pensioner benefits; +£2bn/year for social care; ban zero‑hours in home care; raise Carer’s Allowance; reform PIP/assessments; scrap bedroom tax.

Immigration and integration
- Net migration to ~zero over five years; Australian‑style points plus work permits; 5‑year pause on low‑skilled migration; seasonal visas; 4,000 more Border Force; five‑year contributions before benefits/NHS; no amnesty; pre‑A50 EU citizens can stay.
- Disband sharia councils; ban face coverings in public; zero tolerance of FGM/forced marriage/honour crime; tougher grooming gang action.

Law and order
- +20,000 police; restore stop and search; +7,000 prison officers; keep prisons open; deport foreign criminals; repeal Human Rights Act and leave ECHR; scrap European Arrest Warrant; tighten alcohol licensing.

Foreign policy and defence
- Non‑interventionist; NATO/Five Eyes; conditional engagement with Russia; retain nuclear deterrent.
- Genuine 2% of GDP on defence + £1bn/year; +20,000 personnel; overhaul procurement; Veterans’ Administration, housing, and jobs guarantees.

Trade and aid
- “Trade not aid”: close DfID; cut aid to 0.2% GNI; focus on disaster relief, health, water; commission a 500‑bed hospital ship; pursue global FTAs and ethical trade.

Transport
- Scrap HS2; oppose Heathrow third runway; protect diesel drivers (support scrappage + EV shift); support rural buses; freeze APD; introduce “Britdisc” for foreign vehicles.

Environment, farming, energy, animals
- New Environmental Protection Act; protect ancient woodlands; brownfield first; curb plastics; repeal harmful EU directives.
- UK Single Farm Payment capped; support small/hill/organic farms.
- Animal welfare: ban live exports; CCTV in abattoirs; label method of slaughter; tougher cruelty sentences.
- Energy: repeal Climate Change Act; leave Paris/ETS; back diverse mix incl. shale (not in AONBs); cut bills by removing levies/VAT.

Democracy and localism
- Abolish House of Lords; create English Parliament; proportional representation; halve Commons; citizen‑initiated binding referenda; restrict postal voting; local binding referenda; committee system in councils; keep council tax low.
</text>

Respond with a single JSON object and nothing else, with these keys in this order:

{
  "evidence": "<what in the text informed your choice>",
  "confidence": "high" | "medium" | "low",
  "party": one of ['Conservative', 'Labour', 'Liberal Democrats', 'Scottish National Party', 'UK Independence Party']
}
